title: Reality TV Show 'Khatron Ke Khiladi' Season 15 Premieres on August 12th
summary: The reality show 'Khatron Ke Khiladi' Season 15, hosted by Rohit Shetty, is set to premiere on August 12th. The show will be broadcast on ZEE5 and JioHotstar. No specific details about the contestants or challenges have been announced yet.
summary_points: The reality show 'Khatron Ke Khiladi' Season 15 premieres on August 12th

title_hi: कहत्रों के खिलाड़ी सीजन 15 12 अगस्त को प्रीमियर होगा
